_: The battle pickers' posters (tools/battle-posters.mjs): per card, over `default` (and `mapDefault` for a ground's card, `map-<place>`). size: the picture (px; drawn at twice that, then halved). quality: webp's. foot, riders: how many kinds of each side's men stand in it, on foot and on horse. apart: m between the two nearest men; step: [m further back, m further off] for each next man on foot; nearest: how near the camera (z, m) the first stands; riderAt: [x, z] of a rider (m; red's mirrored). eye, look: the camera's place and what it looks at; fov: deg. frames: frames played before the picture (the men settle into their guard). tint: the glow of either side's edge (red, blue). factions, units: the custom battle's and the grounds' men (custombattle.js unit ids). seed: another cast. mapDistance, mapPitch: a ground's camera, its battles' own (custombattle.js CUSTOM_BATTLE.maps) at that share of the distance and that pitch (rad).
